metas.note:
• Early May black car long antenna

    • This season coverage is quite rare; only found (in order of frequency) in southern Vladimir Oblast, southern Sakhalin Oblast, southeast Leningrad Oblast, Borovichi in Novgorod Oblast, and even April 2013 can be rarely found in Moscow Oblast especially near Dubna
